source.name: Red Bull – BORA – hansgrohe: Flying Look: Red Bull – BORA – hansgrohe takes off with a style update
source.quote: Red Bull – BORA – hansgrohe enters the 2026 season together with Specialized with a new look – while staying true to its own history.
source.note: The article's photo of Florian Lipowitz in the 2026 jersey (https://img.redbull.com/images/q_auto,f_auto/redbullcom/2025/12/14/qphmsaesmd9j0ripzdd8/florian-lipowitz-2026-jersey) shows 'grenke' on both sides of the chest at collar height. The article doesn't name grenke as a sponsor of the WorldTeam; it names the junior team grenke – Auto Eder.

source.name: HUGO BOSS press release: BOSS announces sponsorship of Red Bull-BORA-hansgrohe cycling team
source.quote: during competitions, the BOSS logo will be prominently featured along both sleeves and across the center of the jerseys
source.note: On the 2026 jersey 'BOSS' runs down both sleeves and sits on the right chest (photo of Florian Lipowitz in the team's launch article of 15 December 2025: https://img.redbull.com/images/q_auto,f_auto/redbullcom/2025/12/14/qphmsaesmd9j0ripzdd8/florian-lipowitz-2026-jersey).

source.name: Red Bull – BORA – hansgrohe: Mewa extends its partnership with Red Bull - BORA - hansgrohe
source.quote: Mewa extends its partnership with Red Bull - BORA - hansgrohe for another two years. The new contract provides for greater visibility of the textile service provider. This includes logo placement on jerseys and team vehicles.
source.note: 'Mewa' is on the red cuffs of both sleeves of the 2026 jersey (photo of Florian Lipowitz in the team's launch article of 15 December 2025: https://img.redbull.com/images/q_auto,f_auto/redbullcom/2025/12/14/qphmsaesmd9j0ripzdd8/florian-lipowitz-2026-jersey).

source.name: Specialized: Red Bull - BORA - hansgrohe Short Sleeve Race Jersey
source.quote: Red Bull - BORA - hansgrohe Short Sleeve Race Jersey
source.note: Specialized's back photo of the 2026 race jersey (https://resources.specialized.com/image/65726-140_APP_RBH-RACE-JERSEY-SS-LTD-WHT-RB-BLU_BACK) shows 'AUTO EDER' in small type at the top of the back, below the collar. The page's text doesn't name Auto Eder.

source.name: Red Bull – BORA – hansgrohe: Ready for takeoff: Our new collection is now available
source.quote: The collection follows the design approach developed together with Specialized
source.note: Kit maker, recorded as partner per existing convention. Specialized's own photos of the race jersey (https://resources.specialized.com/image/65726-140_APP_RBH-RACE-JERSEY-SS-LTD-WHT-RB-BLU_HERO-PDP, https://resources.specialized.com/image/65726-140_APP_RBH-RACE-JERSEY-SS-LTD-WHT-RB-BLU_BACK) show its S logo on the chest and both rear shoulders, 'SPECIALIZED' on the lower back, and the S logo on the shorts.

summary: Title sponsors Red Bull, BORA and hansgrohe fill the chest and the upper back; grenke sits on the chest at collar height, BOSS on the chest and down both sleeves, Mewa on the sleeve cuffs and Auto Eder at the top of the back. Specialized makes the kit. Marked complete: Specialized's photos of the 2026 race jersey and shorts, front and back (https://www.specialized.com/us/en/red-bull-bora-hansgrohe-short-sleeve-race-jersey/p/1000277927), and the team's launch photos of 15 December 2025 show no other sponsor.
